changes.comment: Keep node `fs` and `path` off the browser entry's reachable graph. `index.browser` already excluded the filesystem registry loader, but every other packlet imports the `iana` barrel as `../iana`, and that barrel re-exported it — so bundling the browser entry for a browser target failed to resolve `fs` and `path`. The shared `packlets/iana` barrel no longer re-exports `languageRegistriesFileLoader`; the node-only surface moved to `packlets/iana/index.node`, which the node entry point uses. The public API of both entry points is unchanged: `Iana.loadLanguageRegistries` and `Iana.loadLanguageRegistriesFromZip` remain available to Node consumers, and remain absent from the browser entry as before.
